claim: Comparative Buddhist architectural scholarship treats the stupa as a highly structured reliquary and symbolic form organized around a centre, vertical axis and directional orientation, rather than as a neutral mound whose meaning can be read from shape alone.
bounded_by: This is a general architectural and symbolic vocabulary. It cannot date, identify or reconstruct the history of a particular Sri Lankan stupa without site-specific archaeological evidence.
notes: Run34 academic anchor for the iconography method side story.
